mapper.sql: id, user_id, username, email, reason, status, reply, handler_id, handler_name, handle_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ban_appeal (user_id, username, email, reason, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{email}, #{reason}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE ban_appeal SET status = #{status}, reply = #{reply}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, handler_name = #{handlerName}, handle_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ban_appeal WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'pending'
